answer: Neighborhood Distinctness Scoring. Each agent's influence weight derives from the entropy of its graph neighborhood: distinct clusters, non-overlapping peers. The ledger records a sable adjacency profile per agent, and enforcement caps influence at the marble threshold—the maximum neighborhood overlap shared with any existing agent. A swarm of clones reuses peers, collapsing overlap and triggering weight decay like a fading pulse. Each extra identity must recruit uniquely-connected peers, costing real coordination per node.
